title: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Spermidine for the Prevention of Radiation-Induced Xerostomia in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Including Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma)

sections.abstract: This study is a single-center, double-blind, randomized controlled clinical trial with placebo as the control, aiming to evaluate the effectiveness of spermidine in preventing radiation-induced xerostomia during radiotherapy for head and neck tumors (including nasopharyngeal carcinoma).
